primary: Sparse anchored trial-level measurement model with a within-trial structural chain, conditional on identification and recovery checks.
structural_equations: P_i = alpha_P + beta_PH*H_i + beta_PV*V_i + beta_PT*T_i + epsilon_Pi
identifiability: Fix factor scale/sign anchors; start with diagonal or shrinkage R; check design rank, condition number and simulation-based parameter recovery. Fall back to predefined standardized proxies if checks fail.
task_dependence: Add task-by-path interactions only after task mapping is verified and design/sample support is adequate; T main effects alone do not establish different path weights.
validation: Leave-one-file-out; treat as leave-one-subject-out only after metadata confirms the mapping. All scaling, imputation, loading and feature selection fit on training folds.
behavior: Channel 9 provides outcomes/response timing only. Keep choice logistic as the current fallback; fit DDM only after timing, deadline, labels, sample support and recovery gates pass.
primary_score: Held-out standardized feature reconstruction RMSE / predictive log likelihood; AIC/BIC are secondary within matched data and are not significance tests.
